title: Hubble Billing Subscription
description: The billing subscription attached to a Hubble organization.

status.description: Stripe subscription status, or `none` when there is no subscription.

current_period_start.description: Start of the current billing period (Hubble unix-microsecond timestamp), if applicable.

current_period_end.description: End of the current billing period (Hubble unix-microsecond timestamp), if applicable.

next_payment_date.description: Approximate next charge date (Hubble unix-microsecond timestamp), if applicable.
